sources.locator: Dongaria Scarf; Mila Katri; Andu (Goda Mudi)

findings: The Dongaria Scarf entry records procurement from Ram Hial and displays 1800–1899, without dating rationale. Collection documentation took place in 2019–20.
Munda Sipna is separately catalogued as a scissor-like hairpin, acquired through the Assistant Director of Textiles, Koraput, from Nakul Pidikaka.
The first page labels a toe ring Andu (Goda Mudi); this must not silently replace the anklet usage in the separate SCSTRTI catalogue.
A second-page earring entry explicitly identifies Bonda use despite the Bishamakatak site label. Gallery location alone cannot establish Dongria attribution.
interpretation: Acquisition from Ram Hial does not establish manufacture, identity with a person in another report, or production date. An older object could be acquired later; the displayed date is unexplained, not disproven.
Names and administrative acquisition routes are leads to accession records, not proof of maker identity.
Keep each object, catalogue and terminology claim separate.
next_evidence_needed: Scarf accession number, acquisition date, dating basis, material description and maker versus vendor attribution.
Separate katri and sipna accession identifiers and original acquisition documentation.
Object-specific language attribution for Andu, including wearer or maker explanation.
editorial_decision: Retain in KB pending accession-level evidence. Do not introduce a nineteenth-century dating claim or alter the current article terminology.
images: No new reproduction permission established; existing article images retained at 85% text width.

third_gallery_followup.inspection: Full gallery text and item-link targets inspected; individual zoom pages failed with cache misses.
findings: Raw Cloth for Dongria Scarf describes obtaining off-white coarse base cloth from Dombs in exchange for harvested crops. No transaction date, quantities or named exchange partners are given.
The finished Dongaria Shawl (Kapada Gandha) entry records procurement from Wadaka Sindey; its date is blank. Do not equate this name automatically with Sindhe Wadaka in other sources.
third_gallery_followup.identifier_limit: These are VMIS URL identifiers, not verified museum accession numbers.
third_gallery_followup.editorial_use: Useful institution-attributed evidence for exchange in base-cloth supply. It cannot establish current barter, prices, dated transactions or the provenance of the Ram Hial scarf.
third_gallery_followup.next_action: Use these identifiers for any later authorised accession enquiry. Do not repeat failed zoom requests without a new route.
